semiconductor_relevance: Low — the company primarily produces bellows and vacuum parts, which are not core semiconductor products.
summary: DSI Technology specializes in the development and production of bellows, flexible tubes, and vacuum parts, serving both domestic and international markets. They have localized the production of vacuum bellows in Korea and focus on research and development to meet customer needs.

regional_presence.Korea: The company has established itself as a local manufacturer of vacuum bellows, being the first in Korea to do so.
